note: City of Walhalla park (Riverside Park) beside the Pembina River in the Pembina Gorge, adjacent to Pembina Gorge SRA; the camper loops sit in woods back from the river. RV sites have picnic tables and fire pits; the primitive tent area has neither. Playgrounds, sand volleyball, river access for canoeing and tubing (Pembina River Water Trail). The city pool was demolished; construction of a new one was to begin in summer 2026. --Claude
summary: Campground site (linked from the city page) + Bonfire engine: 38 sites with water and 30/50-amp electric (mostly 50), bathhouse, dump, $35 night / $200 wk / $700 mo / $1,000 season, season May 15-Sep 30 2026, online booking on Bonfire. Hookups/sites/facilities/season/booking/fees written. Not waterfront stands. Pin ok. Phone and website flags.
